notes.title: Making a Cozy Fantasy Game in Unity | My Process
notes.notes:
I made some big updates to our cozy cottages and shared the entire process on Youtube. Walls, roofs, trim, windows, and doors can now be customized, from shape to color.  I have also added some home accents such as turrets and plants. More updates to come!
